scope: Independent analytical audit; frozen Simulink model not modified or simulated by this script

model_classes.continuous_average: PI and averaged small-signal plants used here
model_classes.discrete_delay_sensitivity: exact frequency-domain delay bracket only; not an identified sampled-data model
model_classes.switched_behavioral: frozen cycle-resolved model supplies measured operating points only

controller.anti_windup: conditional integration in both PI loops when the limited output would be driven farther into saturation

original_analysis.basis: 24 Vac ideal continuous averaged PI-times-integrator; no load pole, losses, delay, limits or inner-loop closure in outer loop

plants_and_feedback.current_loop: Unity feedback of measured iL.  Around the line peak, Gid(s)=Vout/(L*s+rL+Dpeak*Rds_on).  The feed-forward duty term is constant for the local iRef-to-iL perturbation.
plants_and_feedback.voltage_loop: Unity feedback of Vout.  vLoop commands sinusoidal peak current through iRef=vLoop*vrect/Vpeak.  Line-cycle energy linearization gives Gvi(s)=(Vac/sqrt(2))/(C*Vout*s+2*Vout/R). The outer open loop also includes the closed current loop Ti(s).

working_point_analysis_basis: Continuous CCM line-peak current plant with averaged conduction resistance; line-cycle averaged voltage plant with 40-ohm load damping and closed inner loop

current_loop_delay_sensitivity_24Vac.validity_note: Sensitivity estimate only; phase crossover near the switching/Nyquist region is outside a trustworthy averaged-model range
Sensitivity estimate only; phase crossover near the switching/Nyquist region is outside a trustworthy averaged-model range
Sensitivity estimate only; phase crossover near the switching/Nyquist region is outside a trustworthy averaged-model range

calculation_method.continuous_margin: MATLAB margin(): phase margin at the 0 dB gain crossover and gain margin at a finite -180 degree phase crossover
calculation_method.closed_loop_stability: All poles of feedback(open_loop,1) must have strictly negative real part
calculation_method.delay_margin: Frequency response multiplied by exp(-j*w*Tdelay); crossings found by logarithmic-frequency interpolation

interpretation.gain_margin: Infinite means no finite -180 degree phase crossing in the applicable continuous model; it is not proof of unlimited robustness
interpretation.delay: Delay cases are sensitivity bounds.  The actual PWM/sampling delay was not identified from the switched model
interpretation.nonlinear_limits: Bode results apply only while duty, current-reference and actual-current protection limits are inactive
interpretation.hardware: No result in this file establishes device-level or hardware stability

unverified: Frequency-response injection into the frozen switched behavioral model
Exact sampled-data/PWM small-signal model and effective actuation delay
Linearization during duty saturation, cycle current limiting or fault latch
Line-zero-crossing time-periodic stability and subharmonic behavior
